title: Whisper from scratch, then Qwen2-Audio & Qwen3-Omni

paper.title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision

summary: One problem that rebuilds the core of openai/whisper in PyTorch with the real parameter names: the log-Mel front end of audio.py (power STFT, drop the last frame, log10, global 8-decade clamp, (x+4)/4, checked against Whisper's own mel_filters.npz), the model.py encoder (conv stem with stride 2 on conv2, concatenated sinusoids, attention with no key bias and d^-1/4 on q and k, pre-LN blocks, ln_post), the decoder (causal self-attention, unmasked cross-attention, tied output embedding), and a greedy decoding loop with EOT handling. No training. The full Whisper source is in refs/whisper-src. Problem 02 shows how audio LLMs use such an encoder differently: Qwen2-Audio (Whisper-large-v3 encoder + stride-2 average pool + linear projector) and Qwen3-Omni's AuT (1 s chunks, 3x Conv2d to 12.5 Hz, per-chunk positions, windowed attention) both splice their features into <|AUDIO|> placeholder slots of a decoder-only LLM via masked_scatter, instead of Whisper's cross-attention. Qwen papers and HF code are in refs/qwen.
